Extract right-to-left text direction

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<html lang="ar" dir="rtl"><head><title>RTL Document</title></head><body><p>This is right-to-left text.</p></body></html>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(extract_metadata: true))
puts result.content.inspect
```
